title.narrative: Ukraina: Återhämtning och tidig återuppbyggnad, Svenska Röda Korset
Ukraine: Resilience, Recovery and Rehabilitation, Swedish Red Cross

description.narrative:
Det övergripande målet för insatsen är: utsatta kvinnor, barn och män som är drabbade av den internationella konflikten i Ukraina är mer motståndskraftiga och har förbättrade förmågor för återhämtning och rehabilitering.
Detta övergripande mål stöds av fyra förväntade resultat:
Resultat 1: Byggande av tillfälliga bostäder för socialt utsatta: Utsatta personer täcker sina grundläggande behov genom tillgång till lämpliga och säkra bostäder samt deltar i sociala och samhälleliga tjänster för stärkt integration.
Resultat 2: Mental hälsa och psykosocialt stöd: Utsatta kvinnor, barn och män i nöd har förbättrat det psykosociala välbefinnandet.
Resultat 3: Tillgång till vatten samt tjänster relaterade till vatten, sanitet och hygien: Utsatta personer i eller på flykt från konfliktdrabbade samhällen har regelbunden tillgång till vatten och vatten-, sanitet- och hygientjänster (WASH tjänster) såväl som förbättrad hygienmedvetenhet.
Resultat 4: Katastrofhantering: Kvinnor, barn och män i aktiva konfliktområden har ökad motståndskraft och möjligheter att regelbundet täcka sina grundläggande behov i samband med avbrott av viktiga samhällstjänster.
Implementeringen av insatsen kommer att genomföras i områden som har blivit allvarligt påverkade av Rysslands fullskaliga invasion.
Insatsen kommer att genomföras med ett tydligt fokus på stöd till utsatta grupper i områden nära frontlinjen, men med ett mer långsiktigt perspektiv än vad som skulle vara fallet med ett traditionellt humanitärt stöd.

The overall objective of the project is: vulnerable women, children and men affected by the international conflict in Ukraine are more resilient and have enhanced abilities for recovery and rehabilitation.
This overall objective is supported by four expected outcomes:
Outcome 1: Temporary social housing construction: Vulnerable people regularly cover their basic needs through access to adequate and safe housing as well as participate in social and community services for enhanced integration.
Outcome 2: Mental Health and Psychosocial support: Vulnerable women, children and men in need have improved psychosocial wellbeing.
Outcome 3: Water supply and water, sanitation and hygiene services: Vulnerable people in, or displaced from, conflict-affected communities have regular access to water supply and WASH services as well as enhanced hygiene awareness.
Outcome 4: Disaster management: Women, children and men in active hostilities have increased resilience and abilities to regularly cover their basic needs as well as improve their living conditions during disruptions of essential services.
The implementation of the project will be carried out in areas that have been severely affected by Russia's full-scale invasion.
The project will be implemented with a clear focus on support for vulnerable groups in areas close to the front line, but with a more long-term perspective than would be the case with traditional humanitarian support.

The overall objective of the project is: vulnerable women, children and men affected by the international conflict in Ukraine are more resilient and have enhanced abilities for recovery and rehabilitation.
The outcomes and outputs of the project are the following:
Outcome 1 Temporary social housing construction: Vulnerable people regularly cover their basic needs through access to adequate and safe housing as well as participate in social and community services for enhanced integration.
Output 1.1 An apartment building in the temporary social housing center is constructed and established for accommodation by vulnerable women, children and men. Output 1.2 Vulnerable women, children and men participate in relevant essential social and/or integration services/activities.
Outcome 2 Mental Health and Psychosocial support: Vulnerable women, children and men in need have improved psychosocial wellbeing.
Output 2.1 Vulnerable women, children and men in need participate in community-based basic and focused psychosocial support activities. Output 2.2 Staff, volunteers and practitioners are confident, knowledgeable, skilled and properly supported in their response to MHPSS needs.
Outcome 3 Water supply and water, sanitation and hygiene services: Vulnerable people in, or displaced from, conflict-affected communities have regular access to water supply and WASH services as well as enhanced hygiene awareness.
Output 3.1 Technical water provision for vulnerable women, children and men. Output 3.2 Vulnerable people have access to hygiene services and hygiene awareness sessions. Output 3.3 Ukrainian Red Cross Society have enhanced capacity within Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH).
Outcome 4 Disaster management: Women, children and men in active hostilities have increased resilience and abilities to regularly cover their basic needs as well as improve their living conditions during disruptions of essential services.
Output 4.1 Vulnerable people in among the most severely affected communities are supported with relevant timely assistance.
